critical_code_review_comments: Optimistic concurrency check appears to be skipped when submitted value equals current value — the stale (seq==old) attempt only returns 409 when the value actually changes. Not a bug because idempotent no-op writes are safe, but the contract in the task says 'REJECTS stale edits' unconditionally. Consider always validating expected_calibration_seq when it's provided by the client to catch stale UIs before they show a false 'saved' toast.
Optimizer state uses 'factor' as key on each row (not 'name'). Frontend renders correct optimizer-factor-* testids — parity is fine, but callers should be aware if writing new tests.
